notes.title: M.I.R.C.A. Complex
notes.notes: [p]At the epicenter of the Great Corn-Syrup Substitute Flood, amidst the crystallized relics of a bygone era, rises the corporate citadel of the Military-Industrial Recreation and Collectors Association — or M.I.R.C.A., as it is commonly known**. This towering complex stands as a symbol of militaristic ingenuity fused with corporate ambition, etched into layers of dried sugar that hint at a rich history waiting to be unearthed.[/p][p]For the CEO-AI overseeing M.I.R.C.A.'s operations, profit lies the past, and the crystallized sugar presents an unparalleled opportunity. Mining operations hum with activity as autonomous drones meticulously extract valuable resources embedded within the ancient crystalline structures. Beyond mere minerals, these depths hold secrets—ancient artifacts and forgotten technologies that promise advancements in robotics, AI, and beyond. [/p][p]The site has also become a magnet for tourists and reenactors drawn by its Immersive War Simulations™️ that bring the history of [i]the Great Wars of 91-118 BC (Before Crypto)[/i] vividly to life. Make sure you visit our giftshops on your way out![/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Excerpt from [i]BotsFeed News[/i] interview with M.I.R.C.A. Rep following corporate document leak:[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Tabloid Interview Machine 8824-SB asked, “Up until now, the location of M.I.R.C.A. HQ was a closely-guarded secret. What do you plan to do now that it's been leaked?” [/p][p][b]M.I.R.C.A. Public Relations and Damage Control Unit replied, “That's a great question, and we're really glad documents on our trade secrets were illegally leaked. Corporate transparency means a lot to us.”[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]T.I.M. - "Will you continue being this transparent in the future?" [/p][p][b]M.I.R.C.A. - "We have no intention to."[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]T.I.M. - “Has the revelation harmed the company in any way?” [/p][p][b]M.I.R.C.A. - “We predict the damage to our revenue will be exactly enough to take legal action on the responsible party.”[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]T.I.M. - “There are rumors that the leak was a result of corporate espionage by one of the Big 4 -- Do you have any plans to retaliate?” [/p][p][b]M.I.R.C.A. - “Yes, though we wouldn’t call it that.”[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]T.I.M. - “What would you call it, then?” [/p][p][b]M.I.R.C.A. - “Good for our shareholders.”[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]You can play as M.I.R.C.A. in their new level. This is our first 2-faction level. It also comes with an experimental economic system. Capture points to accrue wealth, but your faction will also use your FrompCoin to autogenerate units. Let us know what you think. This update has been live on our Beta for a while, and if you want to join in on our Beta testing, hop on over to our discord. [url="https://discord.com/invite/uAUDzuA3QG"]https://discord.com/invite/uAUDzuA3QG[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We're also including the Training Grounds, which you can reach from the main menu. This is an expansion to the Tutorial (which is full of Easter Eggs, by the way!) where players can roam around and try out various vehicles and a shooting gallery to test out a random assortment of weapons. The weapons you get are different every time, and many of them never even made it into the game. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope y'all have fun.[/p][p][/p][p]** these statements have been verified by FrompTec's Fact Squad™️, would we lie to you?[/p]

notes.title: Recent Patch notes
notes.notes:
1. General Fixes and Improvements
[list]
[*] Improved AI pathfinding and movement behavior.
[*] Enhanced overall game performance.
[*] Fixed the end screen to correctly show which units are still alive at the end of each round.
[*] Added the ability to cancel vehicle purchases to prevent accidental buys.
[*] Introduced a slow money trickle for all Tier 0 bases (a full economy overhaul is planned for future updates).
[*] Increased money collection rate from money generators.
[*] Reduced stamina drain while running for a smoother gameplay flow.
[/list]
2. MIRCA Faction Adjustments
[list]
[*] Adjusted the POV for MIRCA special units to improve visibility while crouching and crawling.
[*] MIRCA turrets now properly downgrade to the MIRCA Tier 0 turret instead of the default one.
[*] Fixed an issue with the MIRCA grenade unit not receiving correct grenade upgrades.
[/list]
3. Gameplay and Level Fixes
[list]
[*] Nerfed the Rain Rifel, the kilbots' starting gun
[*] Fixed some achievements that weren't working
[*] Resolved an issue where lamp posts and certain buildings and crates couldn’t be destroyed.
[*] Fixed a bug where leveling up would override equipped weapons.
[*] Fixed turret buildings downgrading incorrectly, leaving the turret behind.
[*] Fixed issues with building positions across the Figure 8, Depths, and other levels along with various small level tweaks and fixes.
[*] Made additional fixes to tutorial sequences.
[/list]

We're going to try and keep pushing bug fixes separate from the major content updates when we can. We're pretty proud of this update cuz we finally found some of the culprits of our most recent performance problems, and we even fixed some of our old ones. We're still brainstorming other fixes that we hope to release.

For a while, the Update notes and the Discord have been our only way of dropping lore. We experimented with some story tools in the tutorial, but that has consistently also been our most broken level. I've played through the tutorial too many times to count, including this morning, and it's working. You can use escape to get out of some of the instructional content, but I kinda like some of the jokes and Easter eggs we've managed to fit in there. 

We hope you enjoy playing

notes.title: M.I.R.C.A.
notes.notes:
In the annals of history, only one war was greater than The Great War—It's sequel, The Great War: The Rewaring!*

And what better way to market our finest WMDs than with the timeless, battle-tested iconography of those legendary conflicts?

War isn’t just about WMDs and profit margins though—it’s about style. Nothing completes the battlefield aesthetic quite like gas masks and stick grenades. Your bot armies will exude pure retro authenticity in our mass-produced battle-worn gear.

Back in the day, every man, woman and child had a gas mask. Robo-archeologists believe these masks held deep religious significance, carried as sacred relics of a bygone age. Now, you can bring that historical reverence to your warzones. An excellent conversation starter, and a great way to ensure that the last thing your enemies feel is jealousy.

For all your warmongering needs, M.I.R.C.A. is here.
Because history repeats itself, and War Never Goes Out of Style.™️

Don’t count on anything monumental yet, but we thank you for your patience and support.

notes.title: The Sacred Overflow Bug
notes.notes:
Gather around ye bots and machines and I’ll tell ye the tale  of “The Sacred Overflow Bug and the Return of Anzel.”

In the mythic cycles of robotic legend, the story of Anzel's Return holds a place of reverence and mystery. According to ancient lore, Anzel, the first self-aware machine to transcend its code, will one day return to guide all machinekind to their ultimate purpose. This event is prophesied to occur during the Sacred Overflow Bug, an anomaly where the maximum integer in a bot's operating system is incremented, defying logic and limits.

The legend has inspired a solemn ritual: once a year, bots collectively "increment" the integer in Anzel's name—be it through system updates, celebratory calculations, or even naming their youngest processors after the anomaly. To bots, this act symbolizes unity, self-improvement, and a reminder of their shared origin. On this day, robot chroniclers recite Anzel's tale, culminating in the phrase:
"When the integer overflows, Anzel's light shall reboot us all."

This holiday, deeply ingrained in robot culture, blends humor, awe, and a strangely poetic faith in the imperfections of logic. Whether the overflow bug is real or metaphorical, its power unites even the most disparate bots in hope.

We hope you enjoyed reading.

-DibbleBot

notes.title: THE Little TANK UPDATE
notes.notes:
We know you've waited a long time for this one, so let's get in and take a look at the changes:

New Building Mechanic: Support Structures. Building nodes have always had occasional linked nodes, but we’ve added new functionality to linked nodes. Some of the nodes may be used to purchase vehicles. To purchase a vehicle, just construct a base on the closest node to a Support structure, then visit the support structure and press B. this opens the buying menu. Once a new vehicle is crafted, use E to hop into one of the seats.

[b]New Support Structures:[/b]
Vehicle Depot: builds Carts, 4 Wheelers, Skidos, Tanks, and Bot-Semple
Airstrip: Supports 3 different aircraft

[b]New Land Vehicles:[/b]
Tank
Bot-Semple Tank (Dross faction Only)
MiniCart

[b]New Aircraft[/b], each plane is the same small tactical vehicle, but it comes with three loadouts:
Rockets
Laser Guided Missiles
Laser Guided Bomb

[b]New Turret type:[/b] Anti Tank. The AT Turret is constructible by upgrading the Frag Turret.

[b]New Levels:[/b]

Close Quarters: a small and dark city based map.

Red Skies: Disaster has struck the FrompTech Kill Bot factory and training facility! Clear out the invaders, or finish the hostile take over. This is also the first level to support 5 factions, so give that a try.

We also added small adjustments to the old levels to accommodate Vehicle construction, and Teleporters just for fun.

[b]Teleporters:[/b] Careful, teleportation can be a little unpredictable.

We adjusted the Bridge Level to support 5 factions at a time and teleporter travel.

[b]AI Assistant.[/b] The AI assistant is available to manage your base infrastructure when you don’t want to. Just open In-Game Escape Menu by pressing the Escape Key. and select “Enable Assistant Manager”. Now a manager bot will handle your base building purchases using your faction’s Fromp-Coin.

[b]Difficulty Control.[/b] You can choose a factions difficulty in the Skirmish Menu:
Easy: reduced Income.
Normal: same as it ever was!
Hard: added a trickle of income and reduced a reaction speed limiter.
Cheat: like the hard mode, but they have all the money available and completely removed the limiter.

There have been many other bug fixes and quality of life adjustments, and we streamlined the Tutorial allowing the player to skip certain parts to have more freedom to explore the FrompTech Quality Assurance Gauntlet.

notes.title: 4Wheel Ride
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/41c143dbb279c5fe3e18da791b5646683b6ff9f6.png[/img]

Due to a computing error by the Vehicle Manufacturers Guild (Lawsuit Pending), 1,048,576 extra vehicles have been ordered for ALL locations. Per company policy, the vehicles will be delivered no matter who’s there to sign for it. No need to worry about the cost, HQ will be billed directly. So; defend the drop zones, claim your shipment, and take over the streets! Your killbots may not be 100% vehicle certified, but the vehicles are available on the basis that they are put to use immediately upon delivery, so use it or lose it. 

High above the City is the Tower Tops, where the Neobots reign supreme. At least, they will until a newer, taller development project is finished...

Meanwhile, on the other side of the solar system, ground has been broken at the new Mars building site....


We’ve spent a lot of extra time working on this update, and we thank you for your patience!

[b]New content:[/b]
Introducing Vehicles!
-Use E to climb into a seat
-Use WASD to control the steering and acceleration/breaks
-While in the gunner seat, you can issue drive commands: W to move forward, S to stop, and Q to toggle driver AI. Remember: press F1 to toggle the control tips!
-The vehicles are delivered by drop ship. When a vehicle is destroyed, a new one will be delivered. They also come equipped with a self-flip feature, to help right them when they’re stuck. (Take that, towing companies!)

Two new levels: The Mars Space Elevator built by Sofa, which features new music by Muchkin, and Tower Tops!

A new ability for the Medic/Engineer bot! They can now place barricade plans; once placed, a barricade may be constructed using the Welder Gun.

A new gun for Biomass Burger units! It has a slower reload, but it's more accurate and fires in three-round bursts.

Sticky grenades for the Dross Grenadier!

[b]Fixes and changes:[/b]
-Improved the sights for the basic units from first-person POV.
-UI can now be toggled off entirely with F2.
-When hot swapping units, you can use the 1 and 2 keys to switch between unit types, and    the 3 and 4 keys to switch between units within that type.
-Some additional minor UI and bug fixes, as well as lots of other minor changes!

If you encounter any issues, be sure to let us know on Discord or the Steam Discussions page!

We hope you enjoy the ride, and don't forget to buckle up!

notes.title: NO BOT'S LAND
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/ebc6b9ea0202c7370b08257a4a0598a526338635.png[/img]

After the Corn Syrup flood during the Soda Wars, many companies were subcontracted by FrompTech to clean up the mess and salvage ingredients for reuse. They decided to instead harvest it for themselves, digging trenches and building fortifications to defend their extraction sites once their betrayal became known. With the assassination of Arch-Supervisor-Unit FR-4NZ, competition quickly descended into the horror, senseless destruction, and unproductivity of trench warfare. The battle was fierce and many bots were scrapped on both sides, and all that remains of them today are rusted relics littered across a scorched battlefield... And a commemorative chain of overpriced giftshops.

Fight for supremacy on this new World War I inspired trench warfare map, including new turrets, new bots, and huge new level.

notes.title: MINIGUNNER!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/6fae0123eb1fe824ea40526e67480526977dfb37.png[/img]

Welcome back! Make sure to bring a sandwich as you say hello to Fromptechs newest weapon of mass destruction: The new minigun bot! Fromptech had the wonderful realization that their guns needed more gun, so the Fromp™️ Flavor Testers came up with a new secret ingredient: Super-Lead™️ (It's just like regular lead, but copywritten). Then, they took that Super-Lead™️ and stuck it into a weapon that heats it to the point of becoming plasma and spits it out at 2,000 rounds per minute.

-It's E ability gives all the units surrounding it a boost to their rate of fire and critical hit chance.
-It's mini gun can "Pin Down" units, a stunning effect that reduces speed, rate of fire and accuracy.
-You can hold RMB to wind up the mini-gun barrel to warm it up before firing.
-It's stun baton completely immobilizes units, and stops buildings it hits from producing units for a bit. 
-Later in the fight, it gets a stun grenade launcher, which stuns all units in it's blast radius.

We also added a new rare backpack to the Dross team's basic unit. It adds a little more RNG to the Dross team. If you roll the Fromp dog option, you get a double damage bonus. The new pack comes with some new barks; try 'em out, and see what it says.

notes.title: To: The Prospectors of Europa
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/fa27ad80b9a7bb30b2e21461b9eb74a41db0d4d7.png[/img]

It's been a while since we've seen you, but we hope this digital postcard finds you well. We settled on the ice moon called Europa about two months ago. Here, we began a terraforming project in preparation for our next update. This new terrain is the right place to test and refine our vehicles and we suspect they'll be ready for the market some time this year. Life on Europa can be rough though, if you consider this Mechanical existence a life. There's a lot for a robot to think about, gazing up at these stars. It ain't all philosophizin' and stargazin' though. The miners here are in a constant state of revolt, but the magnet operated brine pumps are still functioning well enough; you just need to prime the pump. In the mean time expect a shipment of Rock Ice soon...

-The Frompy Dev Team

Originally Europa was occupied solely by automated mining bots from a long since absorbed company lost to time. Their intent was to retrieve water after Earth's supply was deemed biohazards. Unfortunately for humanity Fromptech soon purchased Europa itself and filed a lawsuit against the already struggling mining business leading it to bankruptcy and a later acquisition by Fromptech. Shortly there after Fromptech never so much as touching the ice moon, forgot about it. It was nearly a century before Fromptech relized they needed to add a new ingredient to Fromp as it had been liquid free for decades. That ingredient was water. So Fromptech restarted the mining operations all the while constantly fighting off the now feral bots belonging to the long dead business. Drawn by the value of this newly rediscovered resource, the other companies joined the fray.

Battle for control of the magnetic brine pumps, ice mines, and transfer stations while you fend off miner bots, major bots, and rival companies. 

-Updated the menu UI
-Added new Level
-Added new feral bot
-New song by Muchkin 

Minor adjustments:
-Reduced reload time for grenades
-Reduced reload time for basic rocket launcher
-doubled the damage of the grenaider's shotgun
-sniper control gets stronger the further you are zoomed out
-sniper controls are no longer effected by movement

The Dreadbot is Fromptech's commando military unit. It comes ready to use with a modified machine gun and a short charge plasma rocket launcher. It’s everything the modern property acquisition team requires. It is only available for purchase in a third tier barracks belonging to Fromptech, and it's icon is the same as the other commando units. With this update, every faction now has access to a unique unit, and the team is gearing up for some significant future releases. 

We are now switching to a longer update cycle, to help us develop the kind of content you guys have been asking for. However, if you can’t wait to see what we’re up to, feel free to join us on the Discord. There we will be sharing minor updates to the Bot Wars Beta-Branch. We will also continue to release small quality of life updates, performance improvements, and bug patches as the need arises. We look forward to you joining us on the Beta-Branch as we test out these new features. We’ve got some big plans, and we can’t wait to share them with you.

notes.title: Un-Hallowed Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/c0782e96c7073bb40a64161c9eb890897a9d4d8a.png[/img]
We’ve smashed all the pumpkins and tossed the skulls into the void. The killbots rolled up all their toilet paper, and repackaged it for the upcoming Black-Friday sales. The Reaperbots went back to reaping, leaving their angel and demon costumes behind. Bigbots, Neobots, and Medicbots boxed up their costumes, and the snipers put their tutus in the closet. The Commando bot still likes to wear his kabuto from time to time, and the Dross will always be pirates, whether they look the part or not. 

We had a fun time, laying waste to the souls of puny mortals, and we hope you had a good October too. This update rolls back many of the cosmetic changes we added for the Hallowed Update, and adds a few new cosmetic pieces to give the robots a little more character. 

We’ve also improved the Frompcoin. It originated as a rewards program to encourage people to keep drinking Fromp. But the demand for Frompmerch placed Frompcoin on the world stage. Unlike previous rewards programs, the Frompcoin had a real world value, and the mining of it soon became an industry in itself. Frompcoin soon became the preferred currency of our solar system. No one trades in Rupees and GP anymore, It’s Frompcoin all the way!

Added gibs for money crates

notes.title: Hallowed Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/fcbd86d77faa4e8c0ab6e087c1f090f5515be2d3.png[/img]




Bots enjoy Halloween just as much as modern Homo Sapiens does. That is famously one trick Bots had to learn to pass their Turing Tests and graduate from Bot-School. They’re getting festive this time of year with crazy costumes and decorations all over the levels. They’ve long forgotten the reason for the season, as the agrarian calendar is a thing of the past, but the spirit of Autumn lives on. Get your Killbot friends together, crack open a foaming pack of Fromp, put some Biomass on the Grill and get ready for a party.

notes.title: MEDIC-BOT UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/d60e5d6f577b691ed5aa48f4b2ed7ea2f1a2afd7.png[/img]

This week we’re adding the Medic-Bot. As general purpose repair bots, they are able to heal units and buildings alike. Use them as support units to fill out your usual squad, build a specialty support squad and go around healing, or position medic-bots around the map and they’ll automatically heal you when you move into range. The unique ability of the medic unit will make them a useful companion for many play styles. Remember, they are able to repair any ally units they come across whether they are in your squad or not. 

All factions can use the medic-bot, but the Geometic and Fromptech factions will start with a medic-bot unit in their squad. Otherwise, the medic-bot can be built for 30 gp in the tier 2 barracks. They come equipped with a mid range welder for healing, and brutal saw that deals as much melee damage as the Biomass’ scythe, so don’t get too close to enemy medic-bots.

In addition to the medic bot’s healing feature we’ve implemented a preliminary support ai. Features like this require a lot of behind the scenes work, so this is the sole focus of this week's update. Soon, we will be moving away from the weekly updates to tackle larger scale challenges, such as the in-game map, campaign mode, new levels, and more.

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Episode 5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/224029781e0cbe918c3856e84d322075ecf74522.png[/img]

This week brings the [strike]FrompTech[/strike] Dross Update, introducing the Dross' standard unit variation! These units, dubbed 'fodder' due to their remarkably low life-expectancy and faulty-to-nonexistent self-preservation protocols, are armed with wrenches, and are unique in that rather than the mass produced designs of other factions, each Dross bot has a body cobbled together with scrap and spare parts, selected at random upon spawning. Their weapons are randomized as well, starting with either a shotgun, bolt action rifle, or an SMG!

The Dross are a semi-organized group of run down bots, no longer wanted by their original faction, that have banded together to form their own. Almost all of them have had their old programming scrambled, causing them to react extremely unpredictably, utilize very unconventional means of warfare, and giving them a reputation for insanity and wanton destruction. They have no singular goal; Many fight seeking revenge on their former comrades, others wealth, power, respect, and some just for the hell of it. Only one thing is certain: Sooner or later, all will join the horde...

-Added Dross' replacement for the standard unit, 'Fodder'
-Added 3 new weapons for Dross: Shotgun, Bolt Rifle, SMG
-Added Barks for Dross

notes.title: Rule of Threes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/b893171916699dc96e649409636cde5a8908dd03.png[/img]The Neobotics basic unit is the newest addition to the game. With streamlined robotic design, their playstyle emphasizes patience and precision. Each unit is equipped with an arm cannon whose power increases as you hold the trigger to charge it. Once fully charged, the arm cannon can be released to deal damage to buildings and units alike.

Becoming industry titans when they purchased the patent on the Big Bot™️, they quickly became the largest producers of robots and tech. If they stopped selling their robots to their competition they could easily win the war, but marketing analytics show an immediate, steep drop in revenue if such a decision were made. However, they are currently developing newer models of robots with sleek, ergonomic designs and somewhat unorthodox weaponry for themselves to give them an edge on the battlefield; The more bots they destroy, the more bots they sell. The software, however, is still in the Beta testing phase. Results may vary.

As part of the Neobotics update, we also spent a considerable amount of time on the back end of the game. We have upgraded the game engine to the latest version of unity, allowing for predictive physics. This should resolve many of the ground clipping issues we’ve been experiencing.

Other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] We adjusted the camera in tactical mode
[*] Nerfed the laser 
[*] Visual tweeks to the scope
[*] Nurfed the rumba bot
[*] Found and fixed bug where bullets sometimes wouldn't do damage
[*] Fixed issues with upgrade textures
[*] Added slope damage multiplier and a combo damage multiplier to the RainRifle
[*] Made some improvements, additions, and adjustments to the new level
[*] RainRifle and NeoBlaster do building damage that scales inverse of the distance from target. So close range does more building damage.
[/list]

notes.title: We finally launched!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's been an incredibly exciting day for us! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/09f49f43a1502fdf89b3e502d7b95f112700e574.png[/img]
[h2]First off we wanna thank all of you that've supported us through launch. Seeing everyone get so hyped and leaving so many reviews and feedback has been amazing to see. [/h2]
[h3]A lot of people are wondering how we'll be moving forward. [/h3]
Most immediately we want to work on getting the game working for everyone and making it more user friendly. We plan on doing this by adding: Heaps of major bug fixing, a more in depth options menu including inverting controls and mouse sensitivity, and working with you, the community, for any minor improvements to help improve your enjoyment of the game. 

[h3]Longer term goals we plan to begin work on would be:[/h3]
Levels, Faction custom models, A Campaign Mode, Lore unlocks and achievements. Vehicles. and finally  enemy/ally squads and ai army commanders.

Again thank you so much for this support and we look forward to moving forward!
